programmes.d: In a fantasy flashback, Gopher sees the cruise ship transformed into a World War II troop carrier bound for France, with the Nazis plotting to torpedo the vessel before it arrives.
Judy's madcap aunt, now a soap opera star, runs into a problem with her longtime pal. A health book author and his wife discover what's ailing him.

Lauren Tewes returns as Julie McCoy Chenault on board for a reunion cruise with the gang while her husband is away on business. In order to get a job as an assistant purser, Ace must make some difficult decisions.
Sandy Dennis makes a rare television appearance as a woman who meets the most unusual man. Vicki and Judy find that sharing sleeping quarters can threaten a friendship.
A wedding aboard the ship is fraught with problems when the father of the bride faces bankruptcy and the best man woos the bride's sister despite her father's objections.
Ace becomes involved with a spy and his daughter. A professional daredevil finds life can get even more dangerous when he meets a beautiful woman.
Hijinks erupt when rival fraternities wage "war" during an annual college reunion and two former university buddies - one a hippie, the other a yuppie - meet again.
Hulk Hogan portrays himself in a tale about two boastful wrestlers vying to beat the other in the ring and a mother-to-be shares an unusual relationship with a writer.
Mystery, romance, and intrigue shroud Egypt in all its historical glory as the cruise ship crew and a star-studded cast sail the Nile River.

A wealthy widow is insulted when Captain Stubing rebuffs her advances, a young tour guide loses her group but finds love, and a man who recently won $8 million is actually a very obnoxious person.
Emily Haywood (Marion Ross) returns for a second consecutive cruise as her affection for Captain Stubing grows and Larry Gatlin and the Gatlin Brothers try to help a teenage stowaway.
Gopher breaks a priceless statue while trying to impress a woman. Judy is blamed for wrecking a marriage, and Ace gets into trouble with two couples.
Doc falls for a psychologist who has her own share of personal problems and a math genius almost loses a woman due to his gambling habit.
A rock star trying to travel under the radar falls in love and a successful novelist imagines Ace as the hero of her next book.
A psychic predicts the world will end during the cruise and a woman discovers that her late husband arranged a romantic cruise for her and her former lover.

An all-star cast visits beautiful and romantic locales on a cruise to Spain and Portugal. Guest stars include Melissa Sue Anderson, Olivia Brown, Mary Crosby, Lorenzo Lamas, William R. Moses, Cesar Romero, Sada Thompson, and Adrian Zmed.
